options.text: Relevant results, even with few or no keywords

questions.prompt: You want Gemini File Search to search images. What must you do when you create the store?

options.text: Use the default settings. Images work with the text model
options.explanation: The default is a text-only embedding model.

options.text: Set a multimodal embedding model, gemini-embedding-2
options.explanation: Right. Google says you must override the default text-only model to search images.

options.text: Convert the images to WebP before upload
options.explanation: Google lists PNG and JPEG as the supported image formats. WebP is not listed.
